title: Mummified pharaohs in the Cairo museum with cranial deformation, looking like gray aliens

tellings.quote: national museum in Cairo and you see some of these mummified you know pharaohs they look very short. They clearly they've engaged in some sort of cranial deformation to mimic the gods and they look like gray aliens.

plain: Michels says that some of the mummified pharaohs in the National Museum in Cairo look very short, have heads reshaped by binding "to mimic the gods," and look like gray aliens, the big-headed, grey-skinned beings of UFO stories. He says this himself, as something he has seen or heard of, without naming a source. The suggestion is that ancient Egyptians may have been copying beings like the ones people describe today.
